text:
vivian: Quick sync  Optimize toolkit: customers asked for eval-driven alerts + mobile batching guidance. Proposing: ship alert plumbing + PD/Slack hooks + 3 starter templates, and a tiny client helper for batching. Defer quant recs to post-beta. Agree?

raj: +1 on narrow slice. We should scope alerts to eval metric deltas only for MVP (quality signals). Perf/cost alerts later.

morgan: ML will provide templates: concordance_drop, auc_delta, prompt_failure_rate. Rule sketch: if baseline - current > 0.05 AND sample_count >= 30 -> alert; attach top_10 failing prompts.

elaine: CS: Beta customers (AcmeHealth + Zephyr) want PD integration and "quiet hours". Zephyr wants JS/Kotlin snippets for batching heuristics. I'll collect webhook and connectivity traces.

toby: Infra needs per-tenant eval buckets, durable alert queue, webhook tester, and a canary flag to flip on beta tenants. ETA: 3 weeks if templates/API freeze.

vivian: Acceptance gates: alerts run on internal eval with reproducible samples; PD/Slack delivery tested for 2 betas; batching helper + snippets in docs; beta runbook + oncall assigned.

raj: UI plan: simple template picker + single threshold + tenant toggle; inbox shows sample payload. Need /alerts/eval-diff?tenant=... endpoint. I'll mock designs by Wed.

morgan: I'll freeze templates & pack by Monday and include a small labeled eval set for internal verification.

toby: I'll add canary toggle, webhook test endpoint, and alert_delivery_latency_ms metric. Also KV telemetry for batching later.

elaine: I'll prepare customer onboarding checklist and PD runbook fragment this week.

vivian: Owners: raj(UI), morgan(ML), toby(infra), elaine(CS). Goal: beta handoff in ~5 weeks. Call out scope creep (quant recs, full rule-builder, cost anomalies) now or defer. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Event created: "Optimize toolkit - beta planning"  2025-04-22 09:00 PT.

raj: Noted. Will share mock by Wed.

morgan: Will upload eval pack Monday.

toby: Starting infra work Monday.

vivian: Thanks all. Keep it narrow and ship.
